How Quote.Noble works

  • Your data stays in your browser, on your device. Nothing is sent to the internet. If you clear your browser data, your quotes go with it — so use the Backup button under More.
  • Quotes: build a price for a client, mark it sent when you text or email it, mark accepted or declined when they answer. One tap turns an accepted quote into an invoice.
  • Invoices: record deposits and payments. The balance updates itself. Anything past its due date with money still owed gets flagged overdue.
  • PDF: open any quote or invoice, tap Download PDF, and send the file to your client. (Needs internet the first time so the PDF tool can load.)
  • Pricing: Free beta access is currently enabled. The Free and Pro plans under More are planned offerings; no payments are collected in this build.
  • Tax: set your tax rate once under More → Edit business info. Ontario HST is 13%.
